judge.voice: Ben was fun, and I liked that help came on the same screen. Minecraft, creeper, good! The phrase choice was easy because it was short. But I said the same thing again and the second try was no better. Then Ben asked about a house again, which felt like a test. I want a new question when I try again, and I want to know what I really said. The topic list on the phone was huge, with jackets and bookings, nuda. I would use it again for Minecraft, but I don't trust yet that it knows how I'm doing.
